label: CPI · Spain

aviso: It measures December on December, not the average for the year: compared with an annual average wage it is an approximation.

label: GDP · current prices
descripcion: Value of everything Spain produces in a year, at that year’s prices, in millions of euros.
lectura: It rises both when more is produced and when prices rise, so it is not enough to tell whether the economy is really growing.
fuente: 1995–2022 Eurostat (nama_10_gdp); 2023–2025 INE (Annual National Accounts 2025)
aviso: There is a small jump in 2022→2023 because the source and the statistical revision change. 2023–2025 are provisional or advance estimates.

label: GDP · real growth
descripcion: How much Spain’s output grows in volume: that is, after discounting price rises.
lectura: This is the “economic growth” figure in the news. Two years in a row of negative values are usually called a recession.
fuente: 1996–2022 Eurostat (nama_10_gdp, CLV_PCH_PRE); 2023–2025 INE
aviso: 2023–2025 provisional or advance estimates; they may be revised.

label: GDP · nominal growth
descripcion: How much GDP grows at current prices: a mix of real growth and price rises.
lectura: If it is much higher than real growth, a good part of what “grows” is inflation.
fuente: 1996–2022: our own calculation from nominal GDP; 2023–2025: INE
nota_calculo: For 1996–2022 the change is calculated by dividing each year’s GDP by the previous year’s; 2023–2025 is published by INE.

aviso: Secondary source (ICANE). It is an appraised value: it is usually below the asking price of adverts.

label: Years of mean wage to buy an 80 m² home (at appraisal price) · Spain
descripcion: How many years of mean gross wage (INE) it would take to pay for a typical 80 m² home at that year’s average appraised value, with no mortgage or costs.
lectura: The higher it is, the harder it is to buy with one wage. Compare the 2007–2008 bubble with the 2013–2015 low and the recent rebound.
fuente: Our own calculation: appraised value (MIVAU, via ICANE) × 80 m² ÷ gross annual wage (INE, EES)
nota_calculo: 80 m² × appraised value (€/m², annual average) ÷ mean gross annual wage per employee. INE wages start in 2008.
aviso: It is a low estimate: it uses the appraised value (which is below the sale price and the advertised price), an 80 m² home and the gross pay of one person, and assumes saving 100% of the wage.
